decision.explanation: Both Elizabeth Goldsborough and William Ivan Gurney are presented as spouses of Anne Marie Deutsch in separate documents. Document d1 describes a 17th-century same-sex marriage between Anne Marie Deutsch and Elizabeth Goldsborough. Document d2 describes a modern marriage between Anne Marie Deutsch and William Ivan Gurney. These are distinct historical contexts and individuals, so both are valid under the given instruction to preserve separately valid referents.
